data.title: Everyday Tee — Ivory
data.sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL

$media.alt: Simple white t-shirt mockup on a plain background

children.text: A lighter 160 gsm cotton jersey for summer and layering. Slim-straight cut, slightly longer body. Ivory is a warm off-white.
Fabric: 100% organic ringspun cotton, 200 gsm, garment-dyed and pre-shrunk. Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Unisex fit — see the size guide for measurements.
